title: Attractive Faces Skew Text-to-Image Reward Models and Leaderboards
abstract: arXiv:2610.28195v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human preference is now central to the evaluation, guidance, finetuning, and ranking of text-to-image models. However, the susceptibility of human preferences to bias in image generation remains underexplored. We identify a key observation: for human faces, perceived attractiveness overrides image quality in preference judgments, even when comparing real photographs of identical fidelity. In a controlled user study, annotators rank more attractive faces as higher quality, even when unattractive real faces are compared with attractive AI-generated ones. We examine the downstream consequences of this bias. Firstly, simulating Elo rankings from user study data shows attractiveness can invert a leaderboard's ranking, elevating synthetic attractive faces over real, unattractive ones. translated_title: 有吸引力的面孔会使文生图奖励模型和排行榜产生偏差
translated_abstract: 人类偏好现已成为文生图模型评估、引导、微调和排名的核心。然而，人类偏好对图像生成中偏差的易感性仍未得到充分探索。我们发现了一个关键观察：对于人脸而言，感知到的吸引力在偏好判断中会压倒图像质量，即使在比较保真度完全相同的真实照片时也是如此。在一项受控用户研究中，标注者将有吸引力的面孔评为更高质量，即使不吸引人的真实面孔与有吸引力的AI生成面孔进行比较时也是如此。我们研究了这种偏差的下游影响。首先，基于用户研究数据模拟Elo排名显示，吸引力可以逆转排行榜的排名，使合成的有吸引力面孔排在真实的、不吸引人的面孔之上。其次，同样的偏差在人类偏好模型中再次出现。通过单独编辑40个标注的面部属性，我们发现吸引力是最强的（影响因素）……
tldr: 研究发现人脸吸引力在人类偏好判断中会压倒图像质量本身，这一偏差会扭曲文生图模型的奖励模型和排行榜，使AI生成的有吸引力面孔被排在真实但不吸引人的面孔之上。
en_tdlr: Facial attractiveness overrides image quality in human preference judgments, skewing text-to-image reward models and Elo leaderboards toward attractive faces, including AI-generated ones.
